story_info.title: Max's Sparkle Tree Hunt
story_info.subtitle: A brave jungle adventure
story_info.moral: Being brave helps you find wonderful things.

main_character.name: Max Monkey
main_character.appearance: Max is a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail. He has an eager, wide-open smile.

cover.prompt: A Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Max Monkey, a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail, with an eager, wide-open smile. He stands on a lush path in Adventure Jungle, looking up with curiosity towards a very tall tree in the distance. The tree subtly shimmers with tiny, gentle lights, hinting at a sparkle. Warm cinematic lighting, pastel colors, children's book illustration, vertical composition, Instagram friendly. Reserve the lower third for title placement.
cover.visual_action: Max Monkey looking up at a very tall tree

slides.title: Max Hears a Secret
slides.text: Max Monkey heard a secret. "There's a Sparkle Tree," he heard. "Deep in Adventure Jungle!" Max's eyes grew big. He loved adventures. "Adventure is waiting!" he chirped. He wanted to find this special tree right now. It sounded like a hidden treasure!
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Max and the idea of a secret Sparkle Tree. Show his excitement.

slides.title: Max Looks for Clues
slides.text: Max began his hunt. He swung from a sturdy vine. Zoom! He scampered up tall trees. He peeked behind big green leaves. "Where are you, Sparkle Tree?" he called softly. The jungle was big and busy. Finding a secret was not easy.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Max actively searching and exploring the jungle.

slides.title: A Big, Tall Rock
slides.text: Soon, Max saw a very tall rock. It stood high above everything. "Oh, dear!" he thought. "The path goes up there!" He felt a little unsure. It looked like a big climb. He took a deep breath. He knew he could be brave.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce the challenge and Max's moment of doubt, followed by his resolve to be brave.

slides.title: Max is Brave
slides.text: Max grabbed a strong root. He pulled himself up. Step by step, he went higher. He held on with his strong hands. He kept going, up and up. He felt so very brave! He looked up one last time. Almost there!
slides.speaker_notes: Show Max overcoming the challenge with effort and courage.

slides.title: The Beautiful Sparkle Tree
slides.text: Max reached the top! And there it was! A beautiful tree. Its leaves shimmered with tiny, gentle lights. It was the Sparkle Tree! Max’s heart was full of joy. He felt proud he found it. He was brave, and he made it! He knew he could do anything.
slides.speaker_notes: The happy ending where Max finds his treasure and feels a sense of accomplishment and confidence.
